      Attention Dog Owners 
All dogs are required by NH law to be licensed by 
April 30 of each year. 
Proof of valid rabies inoculation required. 
 Renewals:   Order online through the link on this page and on our home page.  Or  you may renew in person, by US mail, or by dropping a note and a check in the drop-box to the right of our front door.  License fees are  $7.50 if the dog is spayed/neutered, $10 if the dog is not spayed/neutered, or $3.25 if the owner is age 65 or older.   Important:   Late fees of $1 per month are charged beginning June 1 . 
 New Dog Licenses (not previously registered in Wilton:   License in person or put a rabies certificate in the drop box (located to the right of the front door) with a check for $7.50 if the dog is spayed/neutered or is a puppy, $10 if the dog is not spayed/neutered, or $3.25 if the owner is age 65 or older (also include a note with your phone number, address, owner name and birth date).
